01 — Table Tennis

Gamified Training &
Performance Analytics

From recreational accuracy drills to elite ball-tracking — technology for every player level at the table tennis centre.

Accuracy Training · Engagement

Fastpong — Interactive LED Target System

LED Tile System · Gamification
Fastpong Tiles — Gamified Accuracy Training
Sensor tiles placed on the table light up as targets. The system detects where each ball lands and scores accuracy in real time. Gamified challenges, personal streaks and a global leaderboard — fully autonomous solo training, no coach needed.
Smart Robot · Mobile App
Fastpong System — Robot + Tiles + App
Complete system: LED tiles + smart ball robot + free mobile app. Configure drill placement, spin, speed and arc from your phone. Return net keeps training flowing continuously. Commercial installation ready for venues, clubs and schools.
Spin & Speed Analytics

Spinsight — Real-Time Ball Measurement

Hardware Kit
Spinsight Team Starter Kit
Specially marked balls + net post phone holder. Measures spin up to 200 rps and speed up to 150 km/h on every shot in real time. No extra hardware beyond a compatible iPhone.
Measurement Stand
Net Post Phone Holder
Positions the measuring phone precisely at the net. Compact, folds into a bag. Fast setup in under 2 minutes. The phone's camera captures every ball at full speed.
Live Data · Coach View
Live Spin & Speed Dashboard
Real-time spin, speed and placement on any device. Coach and player see every shot metric instantly. Strength & weakness profiles built automatically across training sessions.
02 — Padel

Smart Courts &
AI Camera Tracking

AI camera systems that turn every padel court into a smart coaching and content platform — tracking ball, players and highlights automatically.

AI Court Camera · Video Analytics

Wingfield — AI Camera & Tracking for Padel

AI Court Hardware · Dual Tracking Camera
Wingfield AI Pro — Dual Camera System
Dual-camera AI system mounts courtside. Automatically tracks ball speed, player positioning, shot count, rally stats and distance covered. Runs on a single power outlet with Wi-Fi — no technical expertise needed to install.
Video Suite · Coaching Tools
Wingfield Video Suite — Instant Replay & Highlights
In-court touchscreen shows instant video replays between points. AI removes dead time automatically. Highlight clips generated and ready to share after every match. Coaches access player videos remotely via app even when not on court.
03 — Aquatic Center

Swim Wearables &
AI Coaching Platform

From recreational lane timing to elite stroke analysis — every length turned into meaningful, actionable performance data for coaches and athletes.

Swim Wearable · AI Coaching · Data Analytics

TritonWear — Swim Performance Sensor & Platform

Wearable Sensor
Triton Unit — Swim Tracker
Worn under the swim cap. Captures 30+ metrics per lap: stroke rate, distance per stroke, turn time, split pace and underwater speed. Fully waterproof, lightweight, trusted by swimmers from age 8 to elite.
Live Coaching Dashboard
Live Data — Poolside Coach View
Live data sent to coach's tablet after each length. Monitor up to 50 swimmers simultaneously. AI-driven Triton Score shows Readiness, Focus & Intensity at a glance — real-time conversations, not post-session guesswork.
Performance Analytics
Coaching Analytics — Trend & Progress Data
Session-by-session trend database. Seasonal tracker shows volume, zones and skill progression. Team diagnostic compares swimmers globally by speed, height and gender — pinpoints exactly what to train next.
04 — Ice Rink

Interactive Ice —
Projection & Engagement

Motion-sensor projection systems transform the ice surface into an interactive stage — games, challenges and digital badges for every skater.

Interactive Projection · Motion Sensors · Gamification

Xtraice Interactive — Projected Games on Ice

Interactive Ice · Motion Sensor Projection
Interactive Ice — Projected Challenges & Games
Motion sensors detect skaters in real time. Projectors map games, targets and challenges directly onto the ice surface. Skaters interact with lit zones as they move — slicing fruit, avoiding polar bears, hitting targets. Timed drills and accuracy challenges gamify every session.

Switch from game mode to hockey or curling surface between sessions. Digital badges for first-timers and personal bests — shareable on social media. Transforms the rink into a smart engagement zone for all ages, from young families to competitive players.
05 — Fencing

Wireless Scoring &
Hit-Zone Analytics

Cable-free electronic scoring with automated match statistics — for recreational clubs and national team sessions alike.

Electronic Scoring · Wireless · FIE Standard

Favero WF1 — Wireless Scoring System

Electronic Scoring · Wireless
Favero WF1 — Wireless Scoring Machine
Fully wireless scoring system for épée and foil — no floor cables, no installation. Ready in seconds anywhere on the piste. Works with standard fencing equipment — no special jacket needed. Hit detection in conformity with FIE timing standards. Automated match statistics logged without manual entry.

5 operating modes: Épée · Foil · Épée training · Épée plastic · Foil plastic. Up to 12 simultaneous pistes on independent radio channels.
06 — Active Health Lab

Health Assessment —
A First in Switzerland

Walk-in body composition and fitness assessment. No appointment needed. Proven at scale across 26 Sport Singapore venues — ready to adapt for Lausanne.

Body Composition · Health Screening · Active Health Coach

Active Health Lab — Singapore's Proven Model

Active Health Lab · Walk-In · No Appointment
Active Health Lab — In Action
Walk-in, no appointment needed. An Active Health Coach explains results and provides a personalised report linking health data to sport activity recommendations — which centre to join, what to focus on, where to start. Proven at 9 labs across 26 Sport Singapore venues. A first in Switzerland at Vaudoise Aréna.
InBody 580 · Body Composition Scan
InBody 580 — 30-Second Full Body Scan
Body fat mass, muscle mass, total body water and segmental analysis in 30 seconds. No appointment — results explained on the spot by an Active Health Coach.

07 — Smart Operations

Digital Membership &
Facility Intelligence

IoT, data and AI optimising every court, lane and rink — and personalising every member's experience across the smart campus.

Singapore Reference · Digital Membership · Facility Intelligence

MyActiveSG+ — The Singapore Model for Smart Sport Venues

Digital Membership · Mobile App
ActiveSG App — Book, Track, Engage
A single app gives access to all sport facilities and programmes across Singapore. Book courts, buy swim & gym passes, check upcoming bookings and explore competitions — all in one account. 2.5M+ members across 30 multi-sport centres. The reference model for Vaudoise Aréna's digital membership strategy.
Singapore Sports Hub · Smart Campus Reference
Singapore Sports Hub — The Proven Model
35-hectare integrated smart sport campus: National Stadium, OCBC Arena, OCBC Aquatic Centre, water sports, gym and retail. Managed by Sport Singapore with IoT, AI and the MyActiveSG+ digital membership platform. The proven blueprint Vaudoise Aréna can adapt for Lausanne.
Digital Membership
One Profile · All Centres
Single digital identity across all sport centres. Seamless booking, payment and access control. Singapore: 2.5M members, $100 free credits on signup.
Usage Intelligence
Real-Time Occupancy
IoT sensors per court, lane and rink. Peak hour heatmaps. Under-used slot identification for targeted promotions and dynamic off-peak pricing.
Facility & Energy
Smart Energy & Maintenance
Temperature, humidity & energy sensors per zone. Predictive maintenance for ice rink equipment. Energy optimisation based on real-time occupancy.
Revenue Intelligence
Data-Driven Revenue
High-value segment identification. Dynamic pricing for off-peak slots. Corporate partnership ROI. New revenue from data & tech services.

One Smart Campus.
Five Sports. One Vision.
